period_note: Unaudited consolidated quarterly financial statements, Jan-Mar 2020. Islamic bank terminology preserved (Investment = loans equivalent, Investment Income = interest income equivalent). Unlike most other years in this archive, this specific filing is a genuine text-layer PDF (embedded Type1C subset fonts, produced via Adobe Illustrator/Adobe PDF library, not a flattened scan) — extracted via `pdftotext -layout` and independently cross-checked against a 400 DPI vision read of the same page; both methods produced identical figures for every line item, the highest-confidence extraction in this bank's archive. Revaluation Reserve (938,620,647) and Non-Banking Asset (50,875,037) are printed as their own small line items on the source but are not captured as separate fields, per this bank's established schema (matching the precedent set by 2021_Q1.json); total_equity as recorded is the grand 'Total Equity' figure INCLUDING Non-Controlling Interest (24,686,412,830), consistent with the balance-sheet identity check below and this dataset's convention elsewhere. This report's own 31-03-19 comparative column matches this dataset's 2019_Q1.json exactly on every balance-sheet and income-statement figure except EPS: this file's comparative column shows 0.44 where 2019_Q1.json's own primary source prints 0.45 for the identical net profit (470,400,369) — a bonus-share weighted-average-share-count restatement. 2019_Q1.json keeps the contemporaneous 0.45 per project convention.

note: Total Liabilities (362,866,865,481) + Total Equity (24,686,412,830) = Total Assets (387,553,278,311) exactly. Sum of all asset-side line items = 387,553,278,310, within BDT 1 of Total Assets. Deposit sub-lines sum to 293,196,075,693, within BDT 1 of the printed subtotal (293,196,075,694). Equity components (paid-up + statutory + retained, excluding the small unrecorded revaluation reserve of 938,620,647) plus that revaluation reserve = 23,037,021,825 exactly matching the printed 'Total Equity attributable to equity holders' subtotal; + Non-Controlling Interest (1,649,391,005) = 24,686,412,830 Total Equity exactly. Income-statement chain validated end-to-end: Investment Income minus Profit paid on Deposits & Borrowing = Net Investment Income exactly; + non-investment income subtotal (796,495,505) = Total operating income exactly; minus Total operating expenses (itself summing from 11 expense lines to within BDT 1) = Profit before Tax & provision exactly; minus Total provision = Profit before Tax to within BDT 1; minus Provision for Taxation = Net Profit after tax to within BDT 1; attributable split (537,970,131 equity holders + 230,319 NCI) = 538,200,450 exactly; Statutory Reserve appropriation + NCI appropriation = 233,651,282 exactly; Net Profit minus total appropriation = Transfer to Retained Earnings (304,549,168) exactly.
